source.name: The combobox's aria-activedescendant must reference the highlighted suggestion element
source.scope: Real upstream bug (https://github.com/TarekRaafat/autoComplete.js/commit/ec706d39c045b3ca9a75d71546610dcf466d26a4) at de0356005310bd2af2b1a5d97add43908bac6c6f. Blind to the maintainers' fix ec706d39c045b3ca9a75d71546610dcf466d26a4; routing auto.

journey.title: Arrow through store suggestions with the active option announced
journey.goal: While arrowing through suggestions, the input's aria-activedescendant names the highlighted option element

functionalJourney.title: Choose a pickup store with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Clicking a suggestion fills the store field

guards.title: Arrow up from the field to the last suggestion
guards.goal: ArrowUp wraps to the last suggestion and Enter chooses it

plan.root_cause: The navigation controller sets aria-activedescendant to the item's data-value instead of its element ID, causing assistive technologies to announce the wrong active option.
plan.repair_strategy: Change the assignment in the navigation controller's update function to use the list item's id attribute for aria-activedescendant, aligning with the ARIA specification that requires the attribute to reference an element's ID.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: ArrowDown and ArrowUp will correctly update the input's aria-activedescendant to point to the active option's ID, enabling screen readers to announce the highlighted suggestion as intended.
functional_risks: If any external code incorrectly relies on aria-activedescendant containing the item's value rather than its ID, those usages may break. However, per ARIA spec the attribute must hold an ID, so risk is low.
verification_requirements: After focusing the store field and typing 'ma', pressing ArrowDown should set aria-activedescendant to 'autoCompleteJS_result_0'.
A second ArrowDown should set aria-activedescendant to 'autoCompleteJS_result_1'.
Pressing Enter should submit the form with the selected store's value (e.g., 'Marina Park').
ArrowUp navigation should similarly update aria-activedescendant to the previous option's ID.
